roadmapTask: Plan horizon 3 of the agent-agnostic-browser-bridge project (tools/chrome-bridge/). Horizons 1-2 shipped the standalone package and the page-capture read tools. This horizon extends toward full claude-in-browser parity by adding the browser-driving tools that are missing: execute arbitrary JavaScript in the page's MAIN world, go back/forward in history, reload the active tab, and click/hover at page coordinates (screenshots already ship as captureTab).
